category_description: Oil-immersed and dry-type cast resin distribution and power transformers, including specialized furnace transformers.

products.description: Step-down distribution transformers engineered for regional and industrial distribution networks with low core losses and high thermal endurance.
features: HV side cable box and LV side cable box or bus duct interface
Protective painting complying with IS/IEC standards
Standard conservator with silica gel dehydrating breather
Oil level gauge and drain valves
unverified_fields: Numeric impedance percentage (Z%) per kVA rating

products.description: High-capacity transmission and power transformers operating up to 111 kV, equipped with Buchholz protection and remote cooler marshalling.

specifications.off_circuit_tap_changer: ±5% to ±7.5% and +5% to -10% in steps of 2.5%

features: HV and LV outdoor bushings or fully shielded cable boxes
Detachable cooling radiators with optional forced cooling fans
Double-float Buchholz relay with alarm and trip contacts and isolation valves
Dial-type oil temperature indicator (OTI) with alarm and trip contacts
Dial-type winding temperature indicator (WTI)
Magnetic oil level gauge (MOG) with electrical alarm contact
Weatherproof marshalling box and cooler control unit
Neutral current transformer (NCT) for earth fault protection
unverified_fields: Maximum MVA limit per voltage class in catalog

products.description: Specialized heavy-current transformers designed to withstand the severe electrical and mechanical stresses of electric furnace operation.

cooling_methods: OFW (Oil Forced Water Forced for heavy current)
specifications.magnetic_core_lamination: CRGO M3 to M5 grade electrical steel
specifications.electric_windings: Electrolytic grade 99.9% pure copper with transposition in LV coils

features: Engineered for high harmonic currents and repeated dead short-circuits during arc striking
Heavy copper busbar risers on LV terminals
Axial and radial cooling ducts for smooth oil flow
Reinforced core clamp frames preventing mechanical deformation
applications: Submerged arc furnaces (SAF) in steel and ferroalloy plants
unverified_fields: Maximum secondary current output in kA

products.description: Moisture-proof, fire-resistant cast resin dry-type transformers specifically suited for indoor substations, high-rise buildings, and underground utilities.

specifications.tap_links: Off-circuit tap links +5% in steps of 2.5%
specifications.vector_group: Dyn 11 (HV Delta, LV Star with neutral)
specifications.enclosure_protection: IP23 to IP33 (custom enclosures up to IP54 on request)

features: Windings vacuum cast in epoxy resin with quartz filler
Self-extinguishing with zero toxic gas emission and zero fire hazard
Maintenance-free design with no oil leakage or contamination risk
Direct installation near load centers reducing LV cable costs
